📌 Free template and setup guide: https://oleg.ae/yt-bo

I built a cold outreach system in Claude Code and it gets a 35% reply rate on LinkedIn. This tutorial shows how it finds B2B leads, scores each one from 1 to 10, and writes messages that give value first, and you do not need to know how to code.

👋🏻 Hey, I'm Oleg, an AI software entrepreneur. I build things and solve problems with AI every day, mostly with Claude Code. I also run Boldane, an 85%-automated marketing agency where I help B2B business owners with their media.

How I got here…

5 yrs old: I grew up in Russia 🇷🇺. Chess and math were the two things I was good at.
12 yrs old: I earned an official chess rank, two steps below master.
17 yrs old: I finished top 12 in the whole country at Russia's national math olympiad.
18-22 yrs old: I studied math and computer science at Saint Petersburg State University. On the side I tried four startup ideas. All of them died, and I made $0.
21 yrs old: I interned at Yandex and JetBrains, two multi-billion-dollar tech companies. I worked on the first big AI models.
22 yrs old: I left Russia and moved to Amsterdam 🇳🇱.
22-24 yrs old: I worked at Pinely, a multi-billion-dollar hedge fund, using AI to guess where prices would move. I made $700,000 in two years.
24 yrs old: I quit. I wanted my own company, and I wanted to be the captain of my own life. I moved to Dubai 🇦🇪 and posted my first YouTube video.
25 yrs old: I started Boldane. This channel grew to 20,000+ of you.

Today: I use the newest AI all day and build with it. My agency runs on code I built myself. At 16, watching people document their climb on YouTube changed what I thought was possible. Now I get to do that for someone else.

🌐 My agency: https://boldane.com/yt-bo

🫂 Let's be friends
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/olegdoes
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/olegdoes
Want to sponsor a video? oleg@boldane.com

0:00 - Intro
2:12 - How to find leads
